artifact: Issue #9 M4-3 current ingress capability audit

current_capabilities.capability: Canonical read-only routing through descriptor lookup, read-only gate, input validation, ContextResolver, handler invocation, and result normalization.
current_capabilities.limit: WRITE_ONLY descriptors are rejected before validation or handler execution.

current_capabilities.capability: Registers five M2 read-only descriptors through the canonical registry compatibility shim.
current_capabilities.limit: PLAN_INIT_DESCRIPTOR and PLAN_RETIREMENT_DESCRIPTOR exist but are not registered as executable ingress operations.

current_capabilities.capability: Binds the five read-only handlers lazily and deterministically.
current_capabilities.limit: No lifecycle handler is bound to the canonical registry.

current_capabilities.capability: Validates already-materialized trusted authorization and issues exact bounded leases without semantic decisions or writes.
current_capabilities.limit: M4-3 must consume the issued lease; it must not reimplement or relocate issuance.

current_capabilities.capability: Provides typed lifecycle requests, Project Binding checks, bounded retirement snapshots, predecessor checks, and isolated SubjectTransaction dispatch.
current_capabilities.limit: The functions are directly callable only and explicitly state that M4-4 consumes a lease but does not issue one.

current_capabilities.capability: Provides an isolated in-memory transaction fixture with Subject CAS, idempotency, and transaction-local lease consumption.
current_capabilities.limit: It is non-authoritative test storage and cannot be presented as a production graph writer.

current_capabilities.capability: Projects LifecycleResult and MutationResult into canonical envelopes while preserving effect and confirmation state.
current_capabilities.limit: No ingress dispatch currently calls the lifecycle result projection.

exact_gaps: Register the two accepted lifecycle descriptors without changing their contract semantics.
Bind exactly one ingress handler for each accepted lifecycle operation.
Add a typed internal write ingress request boundary that does not duplicate the existing lifecycle request models.
Verify the received CapabilityLease against actual request bindings before the lifecycle handler runs.
Dispatch only plan_init and plan_retirement to the existing M4-4 transition functions.
Project authorization and lifecycle failures through the existing canonical result/error envelope.
Preserve the read-only execute path and keep all external authority and durable journal work downstream.
accepted_inputs: M4-1 MutationIntent, OperationContractDescriptor, and CanonicalMutationResult contracts
M4-2 TrustedMutationAuthorization and CapabilityLease issuance/validation protocol
M4-4 PlanInitRequest, PlanRetirementRequest, Project Binding, and retirement snapshot contracts
